names.details: Rīḥā: It is also called Erīḥā [Jericho]. It is referred to as Ḳaryetü’l-cebbārīn. Joshua son of Nun (peace be upon him) first conquered this city. Inside it, there are sulfur quarries [or mines]. Vesme (a dark dye?) is also produced from there. It is a town located near the city of Ḥaleb (Aleppo), subordinate to Cünd Ḳınnesrīn. [translation]
